definition: INDIAai is a web portal launched by the Government of India on 7 March 2024 for artificial intelligence-related developments in India.
details: It is known as the National AI Portal of India, which was jointly started by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), the National e-Governance Division (NeGD) and the National Association of Software and Service Companies (NASSCOM), with support from the Department of School Education and Literacy (DoSE&L) and the Ministry of Human Resource Development.

explainer.lead: INDIAai is a Government of India web portal launched on 7 March 2024 for AI-related developments in India, known as the National AI Portal of India. It matters as a central national hub for AI information.

tiers.eli5: It's an official Indian website where you can follow what's happening with AI in the country.
tiers.practitioner: Analysts and developers use it as a reference point for Indian AI developments. A pitfall is that it is a portal, not a technical specification, so it reflects national activity rather than standards.
tiers.paperLevel: No formal definition; it is a web portal jointly started by MeitY, NeGD, and NASSCOM, with support from DoSE&L and the Ministry of Human Resource Development.

explainer.example: Launched on 7 March 2024, the portal consolidates AI-related developments for India as the National AI Portal.
